title: Serene Mist
description: A minimalist exploration of light and shadow in nature, using subtle washes of green and charcoal to evoke the quiet peace of a foggy woodland morning.

title: Contours of Silence
description: An expressive study of human emotion and form, using bold, textured charcoal strokes balanced with delicate graphite shading to capture a quiet moment of introspection.

title: Earth & Ether
description: A heavy-bodied abstract piece built with terracotta, sand, and charcoal pigment. It explores the tactile contrast between organic earth materials and clean modern compositions.
